notes: Lamb Weston Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: LW). World's #2 frozen-potato processor (frozen french fries / formed potato products) — supplies QSR (McDonald's, Wendy's, Yum, Chick-fil-A) globally. Spun out of ConAgra Brands Nov 2016. Fiscal year ends last Sunday of May (52/53-week). Data from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0001679273). EBITDA = operating income + D&A. Net debt = LongTermDebt + LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCurrent − cash. Major M&A: Feb 2023 acquired remaining 50% of Lamb-Weston/Meijer EMEA JV (~$936M cash + assumed debt ~$430M) — added FY23 partial-year and full FY24 EMEA consolidation. Prior to FY23 EMEA was equity-method (revenue not consolidated). FY23 net income $1.0B includes ~$401M one-time gain on JV step-up (acquisition-date fair value). FY25 saw normalized post-COVID demand softening + ERP-implementation disruption.

periods.notes: FY21 (year ended May 30, 2021): COVID-disrupted with QSR partial recovery. Revenue $3.67B (-3% vs FY20). Op income $474.8M + D&A $187.8M = EBITDA $662.6M. Net income $317.8M, EPS $2.17.
FY22: revenue $4.10B (+12%) on QSR recovery. Op income $444M + D&A $192M = EBITDA $636.5M. Net income $200.9M, EPS $1.38 (lower YoY on input-cost inflation: edible oil, energy, freight).

FY23: revenue +30% to $5.35B (incl. partial-year EMEA JV consolidation post-Feb 2023 buyout). Op income $882M + D&A $223M = EBITDA $1.10B. Net income $1.0B / EPS $6.98 includes ~$401M gain on remeasurement of pre-existing 50% LWM stake.

FY24: full-year EMEA consolidation drove revenue to $6.47B (+21%). Op income $1.07B + D&A $306.8M = EBITDA $1.37B. Net income $725.5M / EPS $5.01. Net debt $3.82B (acquisition financing + ERP-implementation working-capital build).

FY25: revenue $6.45B (flat YoY) on volume softness — post-COVID QSR traffic weakness + share loss. Op income $665.1M + D&A $407.5M = EBITDA $1.07B. Net income $357.2M / EPS $2.51. Restructuring ('Focus to Win') announced Oct 2024 — facility closures, capex deferrals. Buybacks reduced share count to 139.3M.
